description.full_text: The image shows a smartphone on a wooden table, displaying a messaging app with Chinese text. The conversation includes a response thanking the recipient for feedback. Beside the phone, there's a black pen and a menu with images of food. Sunlight casts a warm glow, creating a relaxed and inviting atmosphere.
